title: Slip and recover
situation: A step onto a slick patch. The front foot runs forward, the arms windmill, the back foot steps under the body to catch it, and she stays up. The slide and the moment off balance are declared; the recovery step must land where the weight went.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
ledger: cardboard cut-out pieces (cast/dummy/ bola, shim, dot)
